maya: Follow-up: canary didn't trigger auto-rollback because error_rate wasn't emitted from the sampled path. Need owners for fixes and follow-ups.
kevin: Reproduced. Sampling bypassed metrics middleware. No rollback event in logs.
ops-bot: [alert] canary-2025-05-01: no rollback detected
samir: Action proposals:
- Add instrumentation to sampled client to emit error_rate and request_count (owner: samir, 2d)
- Create rollback test harness that can inject failures and assert rollback fires (owner: kevin, 1w)
- Restrict feature-flag audience + enforce blast-radius quotas in prod flags (owner: anna, 2w)
anna: I'll write the flag scoping doc with examples (users per flag, env gating).
kevin: Test harness outline: run synthetic load in staging, flip simulate_rollback, assert canary-exit == rollback.
leo: I'll own the action tracker and run biweekly check-ins (4 total). First check-in Fri 2025-05-09.
maya: Consolidating tasks and deadlines:
- samir: emit error_rate + unit/integration tests (due 2025-05-03)
- kevin: rollback harness + alerting + rollback-latency dashboard (due 2025-05-10)
- anna: feature-flag scoping RFC + quota rules (due 2025-05-15)
- leo: maintain tracker + biweekly checks (first: 2025-05-09)
kevin: Add dashboard panel for rollback latency (breach -> action).
maya: tagging eng-sre for review and will update postmortem doc. ops-bot created reminder postmortem-actions #12345 assigned to leo.
anna: looping in security for flag access controls.
maya: We'll re-evaluate after two check-ins and open follow-up tickets as needed. :thumbsup:
